items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: the first band I played with in Chicago was Ed Cary, and Guy Kelly

ctx.x: and you know you come, and I'm staying at so-and-so, you come here and everything, so I was at home. I didn't worry about room rent or eating. And he said, "Get yourself together," and I did.
So some of the first people I met -- well the first band I played with in Chicago was Ed Cary, and Guy Kelly, and --
